chain.why: This means the coverage you have now is tied to your employer’s group policy and can only become your personal policy when you leave the group.
This means a personal policy bought later will start its waiting periods from zero, so you lose any credit from the current group cover.
This shows that a large share of Indian adults already have diabetes or high blood pressure, conditions that often lead to hospital admission.
This indicates that a typical private‑hospital stay costs around ₹24,000 out‑of‑pocket, which can be a substantial expense.

conclusion: Because your employer’s cover stays with the group policy, waiting to buy a personal policy means you will start waiting periods anew while many adults already face costly chronic conditions that can lead to expensive hospital stays, leaving you exposed if you delay.
